provenance.title: A FORMULA OF ARTHUR AND AFFINE HECKE ALGEBRAS

candidates.statement: To relate these to $EP_{\mc H}$ one must compare $EP_{\mc H}$ and $EP_{\mc W^e}$, which is done in \cite[Section 5.6]{Ree} (for affine Hecke algebras with equal parameters) and in \cite[Chapter 3]{OpSo1}.
To relate these to EPH one must compare EPH and EPWe, which is done in [Ree, Section 5.6] (for aﬃne Hecke algebras with equal parameters) and in [OpSo1, Chapter 3].

In other words, we must describe $\pi (u,\sigma)$ as a representation of \[ \big( C^\infty (U) \otimes \mr{End}_\C (V) \big)^G / I \cong \big( \bigoplus\nolimits_{g \in G / G_u} \mr{End}_\C (\C [G]) \big)^G \cong \mr{End}_{G_u} (\C [G]) . \] As a $G_u$-representation $V = \C [G] \cong \C [G_u] \otimes \C^{[G:G_u]}$, so \[ \mr{End}_{G_u} (\C [G]) \cong \mr{End}_{G_u} (\C [G_u]) \otimes \mr{End}_\C (\C^{[G:G_u]}) \cong \C [G_u] \otimes M_{[G:G_u]} (\C) . \] Unter these identifications $\pi (u,\sigma)$ corresponds to the representation $\sigma \otimes \C^{[G:G_u]}$.
